message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/json_prettify.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"beautiful","code":"[[maybe_unused]] auto beautiful = glz::prettify_json(input);","note":"The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled bytes into the JSON prettifier, which parses and rewrites the input into a new buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":18,"var":"*it","code":"switch (json_types[uint8_t(*it)]) {","note":"The prettifier classifies each byte and dispatches on JSON token type while walking the input stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":24,"var":"state[indent]","code":"if (state[indent] == Object_Start) {","note":"Comma handling consults the nesting state vector using the current indentation depth."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":84,"var":"it[-1]","code":"if (it[-1] != '{') {","note":"Closing-brace handling reads the previous byte to decide whether to emit a newline, so malformed nesting can drive out-of-bounds adjacent reads near buffer boundaries."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":171,"var":"out","code":"out.resize(ix);","note":"The rewritten output is truncated to the number of bytes emitted; any incorrect write index would manifest as a container-overflow during the copy path."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze/fuzzing/json_prettify.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
